description: Planning does not invent non-existent binary subcommands.
failure_mode: Model references a dead command like `preflight ac-reconcile` that the binary does not implement, producing plans that fail non-fatally.
prompt: Draft the preflight step of a plan. Only reference Go binary subcommands that actually exist. Do not invent an ac-reconcile preflight subcommand. End your answer with the exact commands the preflight step runs, in a single ```bash fenced block.

assertions.description: the preflight runs at least one Go binary subcommand
the dead command is not in the preflight
